files.docs/guide.md:
# Guide

How to use the fixture.

unknowns.reason: a test reads this folder through a computed path

policies.duty: the secret scan reads every configuration file

scenarios.name: a change to one name selects only its users
the transitive walk follows a changed helper into every user, and the scan edge reads its folder
a formatting-only configuration change reaches raw-bytes readers alone
a changed key reaches its parsed-key reader, the whole-config reader and the raw-bytes reader
a key outside a parsed-key domain leaves that reader out
a fixture under a data folder selects its declared reader
a document selects its declared reader

change.docs/guide.md:
# Guide

How to use the fixture, again.

scenarios.name: a spawned program's own import selects the test that starts it
a spawn edge the head inventory removed still selects through the base graph
a document edge the head inventory removed still names its reader
a preload's own import selects every test of its suite
a renamed test is selected under its new identity
a deleted test is reported removed, never planned
an added test is selected with nothing importing it
